text:
Maya (AE): Looping folks in for ACME. They signed LOI; next step is POC. Requirements: strict EU-only egress for inference traffic, BYOK for model keys, and explicit list of subprocessors that will touch data. Quick sync on blockers and costs?
Tomas (Solutions Eng): Short answer: Hosted (default) MAY route through our edge and TransitCorp which transits US; not acceptable. Options: 1) Dedicated geo-isolated pool in eu-west-1 with VPC peering + BYOK; 2) Private (on-prem/VPC control plane). Dedicated is fastest but needs reserved commit.
Priya (Sales Eng): Timeline & cost: Dedicated lead time ~10 business days after PO + network onboarding. Pricing delta estimate: +$10k/month reserved or ~+18% vs hosted for expected qps (we'll finalize after traffic numbers). I'll add formal quote.
Jon (SRE): Ops note: For Dedicated we can guarantee no TransitCorp paths if peered into customer VPC and we disable public egress. Need: customer ASN/CIDR, peering details, certs, and KMS BYOK setup. We'll also need to whitelist subprocessors per ACME list.
Tomas (Solutions Eng): Subprocessor inventory (short): CloudEdge (edge cache), StoragePartner (durable blobs), MetricsHouse (observability). Full list: https://redwood.example.com/subprocessors.csv. If ACME requires StoragePartner excluded we can swap to our in-house storage for the POC (adds 2 days prep).
LegalBot: Legal: DPA required + subprocess exceptions documented. StoragePartner has infra in DE and FR but backs up to multi-region; need customer sign-off to exclude. If ACME demands contractual EU-only subprocessors, we require a Subprocessor Restriction Addendum (adds ~7 days).
Maya (AE): ACME prefers Dedicated with BYOK. They can commit to a 1-month reserved trial. They asked whether we can include an SLO clause for no cross-border egress during the POC.
Jon (SRE): We can add an SLO: 'No cross-border egress for customer inference traffic during POC, except administrative control-plane calls to Redwood control plane which will be minimized and logged.' We'll provide audit logs for network flows.
Tomas (Solutions Eng): Example tenant routing config for POC we will deliver to Ops:
```
tenant_routing:
  tenant_id: acme-co
  region_pin: eu-west-1
  allow_fallback: false
  subprocessors_allowed:
    - cloudedge
    - redwood-internal-storage
  byok: true
```
Maya (AE): I'll collect ACME network contacts and traffic profile tonight. Tomas/Priya/Jon: can you confirm final price and exact lead time once I send traffic numbers?
Priya (Sales Eng): Yes — send qps, avg tokens, peak concurrency. I'll update quote within 24 hours of receiving numbers.
LegalBot: I'll start the Subprocessor Restriction Addendum draft and ping ACME legal for signatures.
Maya (AE): Great, thanks everyone. I'll update ACME and kick off PO. :thumbsup:
